spans.s:
मृड् मृड् (Ved. मृऌ), cl. 6. 9. P. मृ-
डति, मृड्नाति, ममर्ड, मर्डिष्यति,
अमर्डीत्, मर्डितुम् (Ved. cl. 6. P. मृऌअति, cl.
10. P. मृऌअयति, &c.), to be gracious or favour-
able, be gracious towards (with dat.); to forgive, par-
don, spare; to treat graciously, rejoice, delight, make
happy; to rejoice, be delighted or happy: Caus.
मर्डयति, -यितुम्, Aor. अमीमृडत् or अममर्-
डत्: Desid. मिमर्डिषति: Intens. मरीमृड्यते,
मरीमर्ट्टि; [cf. Gr. μείλ-ια, μείλιχο-ς, μειλίχ-ιο-ς,
μει-λιχ-ίη, μειλίσσω, μειλ-εῖν: Lat. blan-
dus: Goth. mild-s, ‘affectionate:’ Old Germ. mil-
ti, ‘mild:’ Slav. mil-ŭ, ‘pitiable;’ mil-ovati, ‘to
pity;’ mil-ostĭ, ‘pity:’ Lith. myl-iu; meilù-s,
‘lovely;’ méile, ‘love.’]

मृड, अस्, आ, अम् [cf. मृदु, col. 3], showing
mercy, gracious (Ved.); (अस्), m. a N. of Agni or
Fire; of Śiva; (आ, ई), f. an epithet of Pārvatī [cf.
मृडानी]; (अम्), n., scil. हिरण्य, a particular
weight of gold (?).

मृडन, अम्, n. the act of showing grace or
favour, making happy, delighting.

मृडय, अस्, आ, अम्, showing grace or mercy;
अ-मृडय, unmerciful.
मृडाकु, उस्, m. a proper N.

मृडानी, f. the wife of Mṛḍa or Śiva, i. e. Pār-
vatī.
—मृडानी-तन्त्र, अम्, n., N. of a work.

मृडितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. = मर्डितृ, one who
shows favour.

मृडीक, अस्, m. ‘gracious,’ N. of Śiva; a fish;
(according to some) an antelope, [cf. मृग.]

मृडङ्कण मृडङ्कण, अस्, m. (according to
Uṇādi-s.
. fr. rt. मृड्), a child, boy.
